description: Beer prices in a city, cheapest per litre first. Bars' prices, to drink there, come in deals; supermarkets' and depósitos' prices, to take away, come separately in shops (at most 5), never mixed with the bars'. Each price has the place and its category, the serving, the price, when it applies (happy hours) and when it was last checked. Filter by category (one kind only), neighbourhood, brand, format, kind or a maximum price per litre. Open-bar packages only come with kind=open_bar, ranked by package price.

category.description: Only this kind of place: bar (to drink there), mercado (supermarkets and corner shops) or deposito (drinks shops), the last two to take away; its prices then come in deals. Without it, bars' prices come in deals and shops' prices (at most 5) in shops

format.description: Format type (lata, long_neck, garrafa, litrao, chopp, torre) or code (garrafa_600), from catalog

lang.description: Language of labels, schedules and page links
